headword: {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}

definitions.explanation: A small, cross-shaped constellation visible in the Southern Hemisphere, used there as a guide for locating due south.

examples.japanese: {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}を{見|み}たい。
examples.english: I want to see the Southern Cross.

examples.japanese: {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}では{南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}がよく{見|み}える。
examples.english: The Southern Cross is easily seen in the Southern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {船乗|ふなの}りたちは{昔|むかし}、{南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}を{頼|たよ}りに{方角|ほうがく}を{知|し}った。
examples.english: In the past, sailors relied on the Southern Cross to find their direction.

notes:
Composed of {南|みなみ} (south) + {十字星|じゅうじせい} (cross star). The constellation, formally {南十字座|みなみじゅうじざ} (Crux), is not visible from most of Japan and is a famous symbol of the southern sky.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}を{見|み}る: to see the Southern Cross
- {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}を{探|さが}す: to look for the Southern Cross

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}: the Big Dipper — the prominent northern-sky asterism
